author: papagoogs
body:
Hello again. 
First of all, you said I didn't uphold honesty. Like I said earlier, I was honest in my first appeal, and it kept me banned. Hopefully it is clearer this time that I made the video as a last resort. 
2nd of all, why would it take you over one week to come up with such a simple denial response? You don’t even address any of the facts. You just automatically deny me because of the video I made even though there is a legitimate reason why I made the video myself. How is this fair? I know you have been looking at my appeal the whole time, and don't say you were busy, I've seen you on TS multiple times and people have sighted you in-game. 
And, like I mentioned in my previous appeal, tell me how I can prove my innocence then. I clearly asked how I could and I don’t receive an answer. If you are going to deny my appeal, at least give me a valid reason and how I can prove my innocence instead. 
And one last thing, if you are denying this because of the appeal I sent earlier that I archived, that isn’t fair either. I decided to archive it and tell the truth in my open appeals instead of sucking up and lying to the staff, because I believe that I should still tell the truth and not own up to something I didn’t do. 
Thank you again for your time. Also if it possible, I would like Newcleus to look at this appeal in addition to Posighdun as he was the original staff member to have dealt with the situation.
